questions.q: In which year did Garfield Logan first appear in Doom Patrol #99?
questions.why: Garfield Logan debuted in Doom Patrol #99, cover-dated November 1965, as a shapeshifting teen with green skin.

questions.q: Which writer and artist created Garfield Logan, Beast Boy?
questions.why: Arnold Drake wrote and Bob Brown drew the debut of this relatable kid in the Doom Patrol.

questions.q: In the comics, young Garfield Logan was saved from a deadly illness by being turned into which animal?
questions.why: His father temporarily turned him into a green monkey, the one species immune to the illness, which left him permanently green with shapeshifting powers.

questions.q: After a name was spoiled for him, which alias did Gar Logan use in the comics' 1980s team relaunch?
questions.why: Gar went by Changeling in the New Teen Titans era, after a villain mocked the Beast Boy name so much he dropped it.

questions.q: Besides the Doom Patrol, Beast Boy is usually shown on which other team?
questions.why: Beast Boy is best known as a Teen Titan, and he is also usually portrayed as a Doom Patrol member.

questions.q: Who voices Beast Boy in Cartoon Network's 2003 animated series and its comedy spin-off?
questions.why: Greg Cipes has voiced Gar Logan in both Teen Titans series, as well as Young Justice's later seasons.

questions.q: Which actor plays Gar Logan in the 2018 live-action DC Universe series?
questions.why: Ryan Potter plays Beast Boy in the Titans series from the DC Universe and HBO Max streaming platforms.

questions.q: In the comics, which Doom Patrol member and her husband Steve Dayton adopted Garfield Logan?
questions.why: After his crooked guardian was exposed, Elasti-Girl and Steve Dayton took Garfield in and he joined the Doom Patrol.

questions.q: Which court-appointed guardian of young Garfield Logan plotted to kill him to hide embezzlement?
questions.why: Nicholas Galtry stole from the Logan estate and hired killers to stop Garfield from inheriting; the Doom Patrol foiled him.

questions.q: An unrelated shapeshifter also named Beast Boy debuted in 1964's Adventure Comics #324 as part of which group?
questions.why: That earlier Beast Boy, a Lallor native, belonged to the Legion of Super-Outlaws and appeared before Garfield Logan.
